mapper.insert: insert into cart (cart_owner, cart_item, cart_qty) values(#{cartOwner}, #{cartItem}, #{cartQty})
mapper.select:
select S.sale_no, S.sale_name, S.sale_category, S.sale_original_price, S.sale_discount_price, S.sale_reg_time, ST.attach_no, C.cart_qty from cart C inner join sale S on C.cart_item = S.sale_no left outer join sale_thumbnail ST on S.sale_no = ST.sale_no
where C.cart_owner = 'testuser10' order by C.cart_item asc
